Thanks Aditya — looping in Marcus (Ops) and Rishi (Revenue Ops). A few priorities from GTM/ops:

1) SKU & billing model: we need a minimal SKU set for MVP listing (metered token SKU, committed reserved SKU, and an "enterprise support+dedicated" SKU). Please keep the SKU names short and add a description column for Marketplace.
2) Procurement path & PO handling: Rishi — who in finance owns Marketplace POs vs. direct contracts? We should document the handoff for ACME (PO -> invoice cadence -> tax handling).
3) MAP expectations: the MAP should include milestones for listing verification, security attestation, go-to-market co-sell certification, and a mutually agreed procurement acceptance date.

Action items:
- Karthik: can you produce a 1-page SKU mapping + an initial MAP draft by end-of-day Fri 10/30?
- Marcus: please outline the onboarding checklist for Dedicated/Private variants (IPs, VPC requirements, KMS).

I'll coordinate the Thursday slot if OK.
